title: How the loan application process works
content: The loan process has 3 simple steps. Step 1: fill the online application with personal and financial details. Step 2: upload identity and address and income proof documents. Step 3: our team verifies the application quickly and sends an approval notification with the loan details and terms. The customer then signs the agreement electronically and the approved amount is credited directly to their bank account.

title: Documents required for a loan application
content: Keep these documents ready for a faster loan approval. PAN card and Aadhaar card for identity. Address proof such as Aadhaar card or passport or latest utility bill. Income proof: latest 3 months salary slips and 6 months bank statement for salaried customers. Income tax returns of the last 2 to 3 years for self-employed customers. Property papers such as sale agreement or title deed for home loan and mortgage loan. Latest passport size photographs. Our loan officer confirms the exact list for your loan type during the consultation.

title: Loan eligibility basics
content: Loan eligibility depends on your monthly income. Existing EMIs. Credit score. Age. Employment type and the property value. Every bank checks repayment capacity before approving a loan. We work with 20 plus banks and NBFCs and each one has its own rules so the eligible amount differs from bank to bank. Share your basic details and our loan officer will check the best eligible offers for you. The final eligible amount and rate are always confirmed by our loan officer — usually the same day.
